free_text: Decision to defer biopsy for a 73-year-old man with PI-RADS 5, PSA 86.0 ng/mL, PSA density 2.306 and a prior biopsy status of 'Positive'. The panel protocol settled it by the rule 'cohort criterion (psa_ge_20)' (EXPERT-COHORT); It matched the reading urologist in 5 of 6 labelled cases in exactly this situation (prior positive biopsy). The conference did not return a readable structured form, so this record was completed from the minute alone; no finding is asserted beyond the values in it.
